sites.name: Plaskett Meadows Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $10 per night
sites.hours: Check in: 2:00 p.m.; Check-out: 11:00 a.m.; Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: The campground is in an area of mixed species of pine and fir. There are two small lakes for trout fishing, three to four acres each. No motorized boats allowed. Swimming is not recommended.
sites.directions: Located 36 miles northwest of Elk Creek and 15 miles east of Eel River Station on Forest Highway #7. 39?43'44.4"N 122?50'42.0"W GPS: 39.729, -122.845
sites.restrictions: No motorized boats allowed. Swimming is not recommended.

sites.name: Masterson Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Group Site: $75 per night
sites.hours: Check in: 2:00 p.m.; Check-out: 11:00 a.m.; Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Group camp with capacity of up to 75 people equipped with picnic tables. Located one mile from Plaskett Lake.
sites.directions: Located 36 miles northwest of Elk Creek and 15 miles east of Eel River Station on Forest Highway #7. Lat - 39¿¿ 44 ' 15.60281", Long - 122¿¿ 50 ' 50.02505

sites.name: Atchison Campground
sites.feeText: No fees are required for this site
sites.hours: Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.about: There are 3 sites within this campground. There are six fire rings and 10 picnic tables. There is a stream with a spring pipe if you continue 2.6 miles east of the campground on the road. The road is nice for hiking and biking because of limited traffic. sites.directions: Off Forest Highway 7 on 22N11; Section 24, Township 22N, Range 10W.

sites.name: Keller Campground
sites.feeText: No fees are required for this site
sites.hours: Check in: 2:00 p.m.; Check-out: 11:00 a.m.; Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.

sites.name: Grizzly Flat Dispersed Camping
sites.feeText: No fees are required for this site
sites.hours: Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.about: Grizzly Flat is a dispersed camping area next to the Yuki Wilderness. It has vault toilets, few fire rings and no picnic tables. sites.directions: Highway 101 - 12 miles north of Willits, California turn right on Highway 162 to Covelo. One and one half mile north of Covelo turn right on Highway 162 East, go 11 miles to Eel River Work Center.…

sites.name: Wells Cabin Campground
sites.feeText: No fees are required for this site
sites.hours: Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.about: This campground is not designed for RVs or trailers. Beautiful high-elevation scenery with picnic tables and campfire rings. Visit Anthony Peak Lookout a mile away for excellent views.

sites.feeText: No fees are required for this site
sites.hours: Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.about: Two campsites on the North side of Thomes Creek, equipped with fire rings and picnic tables.
